Anya: Quick two-question mini poll: 1) Best editor for pair-programming? React with :vscode: (vscode), :neovim: (neovim), :intellij: (intellij), :sublime: (sublime). 2) Pick a demo model codename: Cedar / Sage / Atlas / Redwood-lite. Reply with your picks!

Matt: vscode + Cedar :thumbsup:

Zara: neovim + Sage :smile:

Sam: vscode + Atlas — Atlas sounds heroic, plus vscode for pair sessions

Olga: intellij + Sage (I know, controversial) :shrug:

Matt: adding that Cedar feels friendlier for demos

poll-bot: Vote recorded: editors — vscode(2), neovim(1), intellij(1); models — Cedar(2), Sage(2), Atlas(1), Redwood-lite(0).

Anya: Hmm tie between Cedar & Sage. Any final thoughts to break it? short reply with Cedar/Sage

Zara: Sage pls :pleading_face:

Sam: Cedar for me — easier to say on calls

Olga: Cedar is fine

Anya: OK, consensus leans Cedar (narrow). Cedar it is — we'll use `cedar` as the demo model name. Thanks everyone! :tada: Lunch at 12? @poll-bot can you run a quick lunch poll next?

poll-bot: Sure — launching lunch poll at 11:50. :pizza:
